sources.title: Data processing pipeline for Herschel HIFI
sources.checked: Reference subtraction occurs during Level1; pre-Level1 spectra can be regenerated; load calibration and observing mode affect the response.

sources.title: HIFI Reference Position Spectra Data Products Release Notes
sources.checked: Processed OFF products are not automatically raw unsubtracted phase counts; load-chop/frequency-switch reference products are single differences.

sources.title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter with the James Webb Space Telescope
sources.checked: Paper selects data without background subtraction and derives telescope-specific conversion/optical response. It does not certify Herschel optical coupling.

scope: Primary documents read through web tool, not spectra downloaded; no independent HSA query or observation-level data validation.
